ops.title: vcs: gt restack --only lost its operation mid-conflict
ops.description: Seen on the rv-spend-ddog lane, 2026-09-25: during a conflicted gt restack --only, gt continue answered 'No Graphite operation to continue', and the lane finished with git rebase --continue. That is raw gt, which agents should not be running (ccx vcs stack submit/rebase own restacks). Question: did the lane reach gt restack through a ccx path or by hand? If ccx, fix it; if by hand, the instructions already forbid it.
